products.description: This classic wool-blend coat fits loosely, allowing layers to be worn underneath the longline style. The subtle shawl collar adds a soft element to the otherwise clean-cut coat. Wear your with tonal layers.

products.name: Mackage Henrietta Double-face Wool Cape Jacket In Light Grey Mix-cream, Size: M/l
products.description: HENRIETTA is a handmade cape jacket made from responsibly-sourced double-face wool featuring a matching sash belt that defines the waist. It features a snap closure at the stand collar and shoulder tabs, with wool-covered hardware for a cohesive finish. Functional patch pockets with flaps add a utilitarian touch, while the unlined construction enhances movement and comfort. A modern interpretation of classic outerwear.

products.name: Spyder TITANIA JACKET Dámská lyžařská bunda, bílá, velikost
products.description: Dámská lyžařská bunda Spyder TITANIA JACKET je ikonický dámský model z kolekce Spyder Alpine, navržený pro náročné lyžaře, kteří hledají maximální ochranu, pohodlí a výkon. Bunda kombinuje špičkové materiály s funkčními detaily, které oceníte na svahu i mimo něj.

products.name: Alba jacket
products.category: ['5598 - Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Outerwear > Coats & Jackets']
products.description: Whether you’re heading to the gym, running errands or exploring nature sites, the Alba jacket is equally smart and sensible. Designed for ease and versatility, it features cinchable shock cords for an optimal fit, zipped side pockets and a zip neckline. The best details? Its monogram zipper.

products.name: Mackage Porter-k Brushed Knit Shirt Jacket In Cream, Size: 46
products.description: PORTER-K is a casual shirt-style jacket crafted from soft brushed knit organic cotton and recycled polyester. Designed with a classic shirt collar and full button-front closure, it balances structure with laid-back appeal. Adjustable sleeve cuffs and patch pockets with flaps and snaps lend practical versatility. Lightweight and unlined, it offers a polished layering piece for transitional wear.

products.name: BLEND WINTER JACKET Geacă de iarnă bărbați, verde închis, mărime
products.description: Geaca de iarnă pentru bărbați Blend WINTER JACKET este ideală în zilele friguroase de iarnă. Manopera de calitate asigură confortul termic necesar și totodată oferă un aspect modern. Este echipată cu fermoar pe toată lungimea și glugă cu șnur de ajustare.

products.name: Mackage Agatha Quilted Mixed-media Hooded Jacket In Cream, Size: S
products.description: AGATHA is a fitted, mixed-media jacket with a quilted front body and diamond quilting at the waist. Made from recycled materials and filled with GRS-certified recycled down, it features an adjustable hood with bungee cord and stopper. The double-face jersey sleeves and back enhance comfort, while subtle branding on the sleeve and front zipper complete the design.

products.name: EXCLUSIVE: Suzanne leather jacket
products.category: ['5598 - Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Outerwear > Coats & Jackets']
products.description: An investment piece that will only get better with time – such is the Suzanne leather jacket. Made in supple leather and cut in a minimalistic silhouette, it’s wearable all year-round – depending on the layering and the styling. The high-collar design is completed with front flap pockets, zip and button closure and a fully lined inner.

products.name: EXCLUSIVE: Annie jacket
products.description: With its luxe satin finish, the Annie jacket is sure to be a favourite for years to come. The form-fitted and slightly cropped silhouette features a button closure, front flap pockets and a sharp collar. Ideal as a layering piece for both workdays and weekends.

products.name: Jannie suede maxi jacket
products.category: ['5598 - Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Outerwear > Coats & Jackets']
products.description: Soft-textured, long and luxurious, the Jannie jacket is sure to be a favourite for years to come – and will only get better with time, thanks to its velvety suede. The ankle-gracing silhouette features a button closure, front flap pockets and a sharp collar. Refined and confident, it’s the ideal layering piece as the seasons transition.

products.name: Jacquie wool jacket
products.category: ['5598 - Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Outerwear > Coats & Jackets']
products.description: A sophisticated wool jacket, such as the Jacquie design, is key to transitional dressing. Both fresh and feminine, the unlined jacket features two large front pockets. Wear over every outfit this season — and the next.
